actions.reason: K3_C0001 has an interpretable immune/proliferative transcriptomic identity, but independent membership is not positively supported. Its set-scope native-geometry alignment is weak and modality-inconsistent (silhouette ~0.079-0.130 in CT/RNA/WSI but -0.007 in WXS), and its set-scope structural diagnostics are single-cluster dominated with essentially zero internal silhouettes, so no boundary or subdivision signal supports treating it as an independent unit. The set-scope confounder report further shows a strong candidate-specific site association (tissue_source_site V=0.588, q=0.0045, with CJ and G6 confined to K3_C0001) plus ct_scanner_model and continuous acquisition associations, leaving a material site/acquisition alternative explanation for this membership. With membership independence unsupported and a plausible technical/site alternative remaining, retention is not justified.

K3_C0002 has a coherent metabolic/mitochondrial transcriptomic identity, but independent membership is not positively established. Its set-scope native-geometry separation is only weakly positive and small (silhouette ~0.013-0.074), and its set-scope structural diagnostics are single-cluster dominated with near-zero internal silhouettes, providing no boundary or subdivision support. The set-scope confounder report shows strong candidate-specific associations with tissue_source_site (V=0.586), ct_scanner_model (0.513), ct_manufacturer (0.481), ct_reconstruction_kernel (0.448), and continuous acquisition factors (ct_z_spacing epsilon^2=0.263), with B8/CZ and Siemens concentrated in K3_C0002, so a material site/acquisition alternative explanation remains. Independence is unsupported and the technical alternative is not neutralized, so retention is not justified.

K3_C0003 has an interpretable down-direction immune/metabolic transcriptomic identity, but independent membership is not positively supported. Its set-scope native-geometry alignment is essentially null or slightly negative in CT, WSI, and WXS (silhouette ~-0.009 to -0.005) and weakly positive only in RNA, and its set-scope structural diagnostics are single-cluster dominated with near-zero internal silhouettes, giving no boundary or subdivision support. The set-scope confounder report shows candidate-specific associations with tissue_source_site (V=0.456, q=0.018), ct_phase, ct_manufacturer, and continuous acquisition factors, with B8 absent from K3_C0003 and Siemens depleted, so a material site/acquisition alternative explanation remains. Independence is unsupported and the technical alternative is not neutralized, so retention is not justified.
